Enjoy,
Bob

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes:
Feb. 22 at Noon EST, The Painter's Playground 1.03 is available. A lot has been accomplished in the past two weeks, and we couldn't have done it without our awesome community of artists and collectors.

[b]Here are the patch notes, please read carefully, since it differs from the previous announcement.[/b]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cleared up a bug that was causing improper displays in the leaderboards.
[*]Cleared up an even more insidious bug that was giving everyone the wrong number of "thumbs given".
[/list]

[h1]Changed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Zoom level has been increased.
[*]The base calculated price of paintings has been slightly decreased.
[*]You can now set the prices of your paintings *lower*, as has been requested.
[*]Removing a painting from being on sale can lower its market value. Seller beware!
[/list]
 
[h1]Noticed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Something I put in a long time ago, and forgot about... 
[*]When you're in the Harbor, you can press 'S' on the keyboard to see which paintings *you* are selling. 
[*]You can also press 'W' to see which paintings you are showcasing. 
[*]I'm not sure whether this will be developed further, removed, or left alone.
[/list]

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
[*]There is now an "Are you sure" pop-up window when flagging a painting.
[*]You can now click on an artist's name in the Harbor or Community gallery, and see all their public paintings.
[*]You can now use the TAB key to scroll through your favorite colors, in addition to the existing 1,2,3,4,5,6 hotkeys.
[*]Press SHIFT while painting to save your work in progress. This happens automatically occasionally, but better safe than sorry ;)
[*]There are now "search modes" in the Community Showcase gallery!
[*][b]There is now a "folder" button in the lower right in Your Private Gallery.[b] [*]This opens the media folder on your computer where your local paintings are stored, to make it easy to share your work with the world. 
[*]So please share your work with the world: twitter, instagram, deviant art, facebook, etc.
[/list]

[h1]Twittered:[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now tweet links to finished paintings:
[*]Go to "Settings" and turn Auto-Tweet On.
[*]Each time you finish a painting in your studio and you upload it directly to the Harbor, you will have the option to tweet it to your followers.
[*]This also works when completing a daily challenge.
[*]It does not work in Oyster mode.
[*]Paintings that are not immediately uploaded can not be auto-tweeted, because there is nothing to link to.
[*]But with the new easy access to your media folder, you might be able to do this yourself ;)
[/list]

[h1]Improved:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Steam Achievement Tracking
[/list]

[h1]Started:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Looking deeper into achievement tracking, due to player reports.
[/list]

[h1]WARNED:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Steam cloud is not perfect.[/b] Due to the nature of the game, it has a lot of files, and this can take a long time to sync up, especially on slow connections and/or old machines.
[*]Orinigally, we had it so that your local gallery paintings were not stored in the steam cloud.
[*]But then users were missing paintings between computers.
[*]So now, the steam cloud has been set to include your local gallery.
[*]If you notice problems, let us know, and you can contact Bob directly at saunders72 at hotmail dot com

[/list]

[h1]The Future:[/h1]
We are working on our road map for The Painter's Playground right now. We can do a small-to-medium sized update in about one month, or a larger one in about three months. 

We'd really like to give you some new painting tools, we've had lots of suggestions from [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/722330/discussions/0/1699416432432714119/]this thread[/url]. Getting them right will take time. And there's also the Golden Gallery to think about, *and* an art gallery companion app on Android!!! So yeah, busy ːsteamhappyː

Keep painting, spread the word, and enjoy!

Bob
NZM

You can also press 'W' to see which paintings you are showcasing. I'm not sure whether this will be developed further, removed, or left alone.

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
[*]There is now an "Are you sure" pop-up window when flagging a painting
[*][b]You can now click on an artist's name in the Harbor or Community gallery, and see all their public paintings.[/b]
[*]You can now use the TAB key to scroll through your favorite colors, in addition to the existing 1,2,3,4,5,6 hotkeys
[*]Press SHIFT while painting to save your work in progress. This happens automatically occasionally, but better safe than sorry ;)
[*]There is now a "folder" button in the lower right in Your Private Gallery. This opens the media folder on your computer where your local paintings are stored, to make it easy to share your work with the world.

notes.title: 1.0 Launch! And Contests!!!
notes.notes:
…And we’re off! Thank you again to all of our beta testers and supporters for making this game a reality. We are forever grateful.

To all newcomers experiencing The Painter’s Playground for the first time – WELCOME! We hope you enjoy your stay here in Painter’s Port. The community so far has been *wonderful* in every way possible. Bob and I will be quite active in addressing any issues, questions, comments, or concerns through the Steam forum.

Alright, now onto our two launch contests!

DLC KEY CONTEST

Create a LetsPlay video of The Painter’s Playground, and post it here on the Steam video tab in the community hub. It can be anything you want, as long as it’s at least 5 minutes long. Ideas for videos could include a tutorial, tips and tricks, or just you doodling. Once you’ve posted the video, either friend me on here (you can unfriend after I give you the key, if you would like, no worries), or email the evidence to Dorkoski at ohio.edu.

HUION DRAWING TABLET CONTEST
I will buy and send this Huion Tablet to the first player who reaches Artist Level 50. This contest will require some serious work – you’ve been warned haha :D

https://www.amazon.com/Huion-Inches-Tablet-Graphics-Drawing/dp/B00DTPYWBG/ref=sr_1_14?s=pc&ie=UTF8&qid=1516049982&sr=1-14&keywords=wacom+tablet

 The only caveat is that I have to be able to ship it to you through Amazon. If by some reason I cannot (or the shipping is insane), I'll send you $20.00 USD through a Steam Gift Card instead. 

Now we said we weren't going to do save wipes - and we aren't. BUT if you plan on going for level 50, we ask that you in-good-faith delete your current artist and start over to be fair to newcomers. Thank you!

Post your level 50 screen shot here on Steam and also email the link to Dorkoski at ohio.edu. We get an email when someone reaches level 50, but this will nudge me.

Thank you all for reading. Happy Painting!

Ryan and Bob
Next Zen Mechanics Limited

notes.title: 1 Week!!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Painters!![/b]

We are so proud and excited to announce that The [i]Painter's Playground[/i] full launch is officially one week away (Thursday, February 8th at 1PM Eastern time)!

First and foremost, we are forever grateful to all of you who have followed, supported, beta tested, offered suggestions, trouble-shooted, and added artwork to the database! We have had just such a wonderful experience with our community so far - and we are very excited and hopeful to have it grow.

[b]Thank you.[/b]

[b]We ask one final thing in return.[/b] To all of you who played and have any opinion on [i]The Painter's Playground[/i] - please, *please* write a review on launch day. Whether it be good, bad, or indifferent - we love you all and want your honest feedback. As you know, games live and die by reviews, here on Steam. Day one reviews are critically important to get [i]The Painter's Playground[/i] noticed by a larger audience. 

Thank you in advance to all those who can spare a few moments to write your thoughts in a review on launch day.

And Launch Day!! Be sure to stop by the store page/news feed, because we will be hosting two contests. One contest will have 10 winners with the prize of the DLC Digital Artbook key. The other contest will win you a Huion drawing tablet (4 x 2.23 In OSU Tablet)!

Happy Painting!!!

Best,

[b]Ryan & Bob[/b]
[b][i]Next Zen Mechanics[/i][/b]

notes.title: Beta 5c
notes.notes:
The second update for 2018 is here, with the following notable changes:
[list]
[*]added the names of colors to pop-ups in merchant and during play. Thank you color consultant!
[*]we have a new 4th tab of colors, including flesh tones, metals, and royals.
[*]took out a lot of superfluous server calls.
[*]found another security hole and patched it ;)
[*]there is now a "cancel" button when selecting canvas size, meaning you don't always have to start a painting.
[*]added a "button pressing animation" to some things in the studio.
[*]the "achievements" screen is now called "Career", and has more infomation and several sub-options.
[*]UI skins can now be purchased at the crafty merchant, and turned on in the "Career" screen, from the main menu.
[*]other new crafty merchant functions are also activated.
[*]sound effects have been updated
[*]added new steam achievements, for a current total of 96!
[/list]

On the forums, I mentioned I would try putting the canvas behind the UI during painting. Well, I tried it, and it completely conflicted with the way painting and tool selection work. 

Final polish work continues, launch is less than 1 month away!

Bob, NZM

notes.title: Beta 4G
notes.notes:
12/15/17 , The Painter's Playground, Beta 4G

This update contains changes to the Daily Challenge, an accuracy fix for the detail pen and paint bucket, and some new one-time pop-up menus for galleries.

The version number displayed on the first screen is wrong! It says '4f'. Ignore that.... Now the things I got right:

[list]
[*] i improved the accuracy of the detail pen
[*] i made it so that a first-time player would go straight to the studio
[*] i fixed an error (caused by the above change), where new users would be unable to do anything (WHOA!)
[*] i found the error that was making people's paintings upload under the wrong user number! (i also fixed it)
[*] i set up the "featured artist" search in the Harbor.
[*] i fixed an issue for canvas detection in portrait mode
[*] i fixed the error where selecting paint bucket would change brush size.
[*] i created a pop-up window that allows you to view the daily challenge gallery without creating an entry
[*] you now receive a copy of all paintings you make in the daily challenge.
[*] you may now vote on Daily Challenge paintings from previous days
[*] there is no longer a "winner" for daily challenges, judge for yourself! 
[*] I changed the amount of Bits and Renown you get for making Daily Draws: it scales with artist level.
[*] each vote cast now costs 10 bits.
[*] voting 3 times in 1 play session grants +1 renown per second for 12 hours.
[*] the first time you view a gallery, you get a pop-up about it. For existing users, i apologize, but it will only happen once!

[/list]

OK, enjoy, and please send any technical issues to me (Bob) at
saunders72 at hotmail dot com

notes.title: Security Update
notes.notes:
Hello Artists!

Today I released a new version of The Painter's Playground on steam that addresses several existing technical issues. 

[b]Warning:[/b]
Your current temporary "work in progress" files will be invalidated by this update. So finish whatever you're doing before getting this. (no other files will be affected)

[list]
[*] added: skip button for daily challenge: just go straight to daily challenge gallery
[*] added: for now, everyone gets a new random ui every time they enter a painting screen. these will later be purchasable.
[*] added: a prototype "level up progress bar"
[*] added: many new steam achievements!

[*] changed: level up screen format. each point is now a separate screen

[*] fixed several security issues discovered by one of our awesome community members
[*] fixed a server session time-out issue
[*] fixed several leaderboard-related issues
[/list]

Thanks for playing, and keep up the great work!

Bob, Next Zen Mechanics

notes.title: Steam Build Updated
notes.notes:
` added new graphical help screens
` added some new Help screens for canvas selection and gallery close-ups (text only at this time)
` added a "Help" button in lower left, same as F1 key 
` added "Are You Sure?" to crafty merchant purchases
` you can now start painting when the brush is off the canvas (for getting just a touch on the edge with a large brush)
` added some visual effects
` completely remodeled the level-up system, to include many more character levels, and space out the rewards.
` giving a painting a Thumbs Up now cost 3 Bits. 
` voting on 3 paintings gives +1 renown per second for 12 hours.
` you can no longer vote / thumbs up on art that you own
` included 2 new steam achievements: lifetime renown earned and total votes cast / thumbs given. MORE TO COME!
` added new Showcase and For Sale boxes to your gallery
` fixed some issues with favorite colors being transferred between painting modes.
` fixed some issues with the tutorial. If you are STUCK in the TUTORIAL, press the SPACE BAR!


` changed the starting canvas (default) back to pure white. "realistic" will be a "setting" in future.
` fixed an undo error that switched data between different game modes.
` put the revised "water color brush" in the game.
` the game will now send you a welcome email when you create an artist identity.
` if you remember the artist name and email address you used, you can get an email of your password !
` leaderboards now show your score even if you are not in the top 10

notes.title: DRM-Free Versions of TPP Will Be Available
notes.notes:
Anyone interested in DRM-Free version of [i]The Painter's Playground[/i] can simply follow us/wishlist over at [url=https://nextzenmechanics.itch.io/the-painters-playground]Itch[/url] and/or [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/store/the-painters-playground?hmb_source=search_bar]Humble[/url]!

There is also a Humble Deluxe Version in the works which will include an art booklet featuring all the unedited oil paintings by Russell Murray. Plus two bonus paintings. This will also include thoughts/inspirations/lore/background text for each image.

The art booklet is something fans of oil paintings will probably enjoy browsing through. The DLC art booklet will also be available on Steam shortly after release.

Thank you all very much for following! [b]Keep on painting![/b]

Best,

[url=http://nextzenmechanics.com/blog/]The Next Zen Mechanics[/url]
